data.body: Initial rebar-debug Phase 1 evidence (investigation intentionally stopped for separate ownership): exact extras-enforced full suite failed only this node after 1:33:35 (13,582 passed); focused outer reproduction failed in 105.55s with `TimeoutExpired` after captured inner stdout already contained `.[100%]`. A direct inner pytest invocation under the same env printed `[100%]` and exited before a process snapshot could attach. A subsequent unchanged outer invocation passed in 1.49s. Therefore the defect is intermittent shutdown/liveness after successful test execution, not a deterministic assertion failure. Competing mechanisms remain unproven: non-daemon thread, live child, inherited capture pipe, or plugin teardown. No code or tests were edited, no retry was treated as resolution, and no RCA is claimed. Next owner must continue Phase 1 in a fresh origin/main worktree, quantify the failure rate, and capture the live process/thread/pipe state during an actual timeout before Phase 2.
